readings.E1: calendar = D17's dates of the book from its first date to 2026-08-21; D18 prices on other dates are never read
readings.E2: decision dates = T0 and the last D17 session of every later ISO week; the decision at the last session is not traded
readings.E3: label = latest Master row dated <= decision date, per index; IN iff all three SIGN are BUY
readings.E4: initial position at T0 close, no cost: OUT = 50% GOLDBEES, 50% cash; IN = the basket in force at T0 as drifted since its availableDate (OHLC4 of the first D18 session on or after it), scaled to NAV 1
readings.E5: a basket takes effect on the first calendar session on or after its availableDate; baskets flagged csv_only_skipped are dropped; weights are renormalised to 1
readings.E6: stock fill = OHLC4 of the Eikon bar (close if any of open/high/low is blank; last close if the stock has no bar that session)
readings.E7: costs: one rule for every trade, see the module docstring (cost on the value traded, targets scaled by (V-cost)/V)
readings.E8: a basket change while IN trades from the old holdings to the new basket (delta trades); while OUT nothing is traded
readings.E9: a switch and a basket change on the same session: the switch trades into / out of the basket in force that session
readings.E10: cash level: LBES as-of on sessions; after the file's last date (2026-08-09) it compounds at the trailing 90-session daily rate measured on the last 90 sessions up to 2026-08-07
readings.E11: constant mix: stock share f = invested decision weeks / decision weeks, rebalanced at every decision's next session and at every basket change; initial stock holding = drifted basket scaled by f
readings.E12: V3 is evaluated on the N4.9 draws; for the circular shift, invested weeks must be identical and the spell-count gap is reported
readings.E13: R4 live window starts at the first D17 session on or after 2021-11-01 with its own spells, own draws (same seeds) and free initial position in the state decided then
readings.E14: R3 cash = LBES to the session before 2024-01-24, then chained with the desk's LIQUIDCASE returns on sessions
readings.E15: V4 runs the always-in book to 2026-10-22 (the G0 scope); every other run ends on 2026-08-21

run.name: smoke
run.seed: numpy default_rng([3, draw_id]); the same draw ids for every book, cost, window and cash variant
